rules.description: Eligible scholarship applicants must provide their Aadhaar number when applying for the scholarship.
rules.condition: The applicant is an eligible applicant applying for the scholarship.
rules.outcome: Aadhaar number must be submitted with the application.
rules.evidence_quote: it will be necessary for the eligible applicants to provide Aadhaar number while applying for the scholarship

rules.description: Applicants who do not possess an Aadhaar number may submit alternative identification documents as specified in the Gazette Notification.
rules.condition: The applicant does not possess an Aadhaar number.
rules.outcome: They may provide any of the listed alternative documents (e.g., Aadhaar Enrolment ID slip, request copy, bank passbook with photograph, Ration Card, PAN Card, Passport, school identity certificate, driving license, or other documents specified by the State Government or Union territory Administration).
rules.evidence_quote: in case, an individual does not possess Aadhaar one can provide the details of alternative identification documents, as stated in the Gazette Notification, detailed below:

rules.description: For applicants from Assam, Jammu & Kashmir, and Meghalaya, only the documents listed in paragraph (b) are required.
rules.condition: The applicant resides in Assam, Jammu & Kashmir, or Meghalaya.
rules.outcome: Only the documents mentioned at para (b) shall be required.
rules.evidence_quote: [Note- For Assam, Jammu & Kashmir and Meghalaya, the documents mentioned at para (b) shall only be required]
